findings.title: Parametric transfer uses the posterior mean, not the MAP mode argued for in the paper
findings.expected: the claim in the paper holds
findings.observed: line 204 calls .mean() on the posterior; the paper argues for the MAP mode
findings.reproducible: yes — static read of the cited lines

findings.title: Transfer potential has the wrong sign in complete and individual pooling (anti-regularizer)
findings.expected: the claim in the paper holds
findings.observed: the complete branch adds +abs(slope - transferred); a regularizer needs the negative sign
findings.reproducible: yes — static read of the cited lines

findings.title: FourierSeasonality regularization scale lam is inconsistent across pooling modes (~22x)
findings.expected: the claim in the paper holds
findings.observed: complete uses lam=2*period/n while partial uses lam=2*n_group, a 22x ratio, and the paper documents no lam
findings.reproducible: yes — static read of the cited lines

findings.title: Test-set configuration selection with no validation split
findings.expected: the claim in the paper holds
findings.observed: the lowest MAPE on the test horizon is selected over a 2592-config grid; no validation split exists
findings.reproducible: yes — static read of the cited lines

findings.title: The Prophet baseline is a Vangja ablation: no prophet import anywhere in the runners
findings.expected: the claim in the paper holds
findings.observed: the baseline is labelled Prophet but imports only vangja; pyproject.toml has no prophet dependency
findings.reproducible: yes — static read of the cited lines

findings.title: PyMC is not a declared dependency; the sampler stack floats on every install
findings.expected: the claim in the paper holds
findings.observed: pyproject dependencies omit pymc; it enters transitively unpinned
findings.reproducible: yes — static read of the cited lines

findings.title: No random seed anywhere in fit(), the runners, SLURM, or the container
findings.expected: the claim in the paper holds
findings.observed: pm.sample has no random_seed argument and no runner records a seed
findings.reproducible: yes — static read of the cited lines
